plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: The separate build-70450 available-section reader omits unknown TACT sections from materialized rows and retains their declared coverage facts. Unavailable bytes in an admitted section are fatal.
source_policy.dependencies: Map and all three liquid startup tables remain mandatory. Only explicit MissingFile at WDT/root ADT is an admitted omission; all other acquisition, decoding, conversion, integrity, resource and publication errors remain fatal.
source_policy.failure: Unavailable WDT produces a zero tilelist with unknown MAIN; a known-present root ADT that is MissingFile clears its output/list bit and continues. Every selected map has a tilelist. No empty-MAIN inference follows unavailable WDT.

facts: Global Map sections and independent CKey/encoded-key authentication flags
Selected source order, plan indices and materialized ordinals
Loaded WDT known MAIN present/absent counts or unavailable WDT unknown coordinates
Converted tiles and explicit MissingFile root ADT omission counts

verification.both_commands: Metadata preflight before payload allocation; checks producer-reported coverage, exact coverage/list/tile inventory, build-70450 MAPS/tilelist structural formats, equal complete tile/list bitsets and counts. This does not authenticate client sources or establish format parity.
verification.source_authentication: Offline verification checks producer-reported source coverage, not an independent client snapshot.

resume: Same-context incomplete output only; rerun terrain and compare retained artifacts through existing Run receipts before finishing. Complete output refuses writes.

limits.meaning: Downward-only API budgets; package/sink reservations subtract from the combined core ceiling. Logical counters are not RSS or all CPU operations. Cap failures do not truncate output.

legacy_preservation: Revisions 12 through 19 and their contracts, fixtures and output envelopes are unchanged; v20 is a separate plan/publication/coverage capability.
